sender.tl: “DSWD”, “NDRRMC”, “GCash” o isang Facebook page o Messenger account na gumagamit ng pangalan ng DSWD
sender.en: “DSWD”, “NDRRMC”, “GCash” or a Facebook page or Messenger account using DSWD’s name

name.tl: Pekeng ayuda: “nakatanggap ka ng ayuda, i-confirm sa link” o “magbayad para ma-release”
name.en: Fake cash aid (ayuda): “aid sent to your e-wallet, confirm the link” or “release fee”

how.tl: May text, Facebook post o Messenger chat na nagsasabing makakakuha ka ng ayuda mula sa DSWD (AICS, 4Ps, AKAP), calamity assistance o fuel subsidy, o na naipadala na ang ayuda sa GCash mo. Para makuha ito, kailangan mong mag-click ng link, mag-fill out ng form ng personal mong detalye, o magbayad ng “release fee”. Ninanakaw ng link ang login ng e-wallet mo, at hindi na babalik ang ibinayad. Sabi ng DSWD, hindi sila humihingi ng bayad para sa ayuda at hindi sila nagpapadala ng link sa text.
how.en: A text, Facebook post or Messenger chat says you can get cash aid from the DSWD (AICS, 4Ps, AKAP), calamity assistance or a fuel subsidy, or that aid was already sent to your GCash. To claim it you must click a link, fill in a form with your personal details, or pay a “release fee”. The link steals your e-wallet login, and the fee is lost. The DSWD says it never asks for money to release aid and does not send links by text.

text.tl: May mensaheng gumagamit ng pangalan ng DSWD, NDRRMC o isang programa ng ayuda.
text.en: A message uses the name of the DSWD, NDRRMC or a cash aid program.

text.tl: Nangangako ito ng libu-libong piso o sinasabing nasa e-wallet mo na ang ayuda.
text.en: It promises thousands of pesos or says aid is already in your e-wallet.

text.tl: Kailangan daw i-claim ngayon o mawawala ang ayuda.
text.en: You must claim today or the aid will be forfeited.

text.tl: May link o form para sa detalye mo at login ng e-wallet.
text.en: It gives a link or form for your details and e-wallet login.

text.tl: May humihingi ng bayad bago i-release ang ayuda.
text.en: Some ask for a fee before the aid is released.

text.tl: DSWD AICS: Approved po kayo sa P7,500 na cash assistance. Pakisagot ang form at bayaran ang P500 processing fee via GCash para ma-release bukas: [link]
text.en: DSWD AICS: Approved po kayo sa P7,500 na cash assistance. Pakisagot ang form at bayaran ang P500 processing fee via GCash para ma-release bukas: [link]

tl: Ayudang inaalok sa text, chat o online form.
Link para “i-confirm” ang pera sa e-wallet mo.
en: Cash aid offered by text, chat or an online form.
A link to “confirm” money in your e-wallet.

tl: Huwag mag-click o magbayad. Libre ang serbisyo ng DSWD at hindi ito humihingi ng release fee.
Magtanong sa DSWD field office o local social welfare office, o sa opisyal na website at Facebook page ng DSWD.
Kung nailagay mo ang login ng e-wallet mo, i-lock ang account sa app at tawagan ang hotline nito.
I-report ang mensahe sa CICC hotline 1326.
en: Don’t click or pay. DSWD services are free and it never asks for a release fee.
Check with your DSWD field office or local social welfare office, or the official DSWD website and Facebook page.
If you entered your e-wallet login, lock the account in the app and call its hotline.
Report the message to the CICC hotline 1326.
